content: The following are the definitions of anemia and gastrointestinal blood loss as used in various studies, along with the corresponding references: 1. Morley (1999): Anemia was defined as a hemoglobin level below 110 g/L. No definition for gastrointestinal blood loss was provided. 2. Fuchs (1993): Anemia was defined as hemoglobin (Hb) levels less than 105 g/L. No definition for gastrointestinal blood loss was provided. 3. Thorisdottir (2013): Iron deficiency anemia (IDA) was defined using the following criteria: hemoglobin (Hb) levels below 105 g/L, mean corpuscular volume (MCV) less than 74 fL, and serum ferritin (SF) levels below 12 µg/L. No definition for gastrointestinal blood loss was provided. 4. Tunnessen (1987): Anemia was defined as hemoglobin levels below 11 g/dL. No definition for gastrointestinal blood loss was provided. 5. Fomon (1981): No definition for anemia was provided. Gastrointestinal blood loss was defined as guaiac-positive stools at 196 days of age. 6. Ziegler (1990): No definition for anemia was provided. Gastrointestinal blood loss was defined as guaiac-positive stools at 252 days of age. Abbreviations: n/a indicates that the information was not available in the respective study.
